soil.title: Soil investigation and parameters
soil.description: Enter borehole, CPT and laboratory data. Define the layers and design parameters.
soil.layering.intro: The program proposes layer boundaries; nothing is approved. You review the proposal and then create a profile from it. Design parameters stay unset until you approve them.
soil.layering.no_sources.cpt: The project has no CPT soundings. Import one in Site data first.
soil.layering.no_sources.spt: The project has no boreholes. Import one in Site data first.
soil.layering.setting.n_change_ratio: SPT: relative N change for a new layer
soil.layering.not_approved: Proposal only. Nothing is approved automatically.
soil.layering.gwt_hint: Required. Prefilled from the sounding when it recorded one; check it.
soil.layering.create_blocked: Enter every unit weight, the groundwater depth and a name first.
soil.layering.stale: Settings changed: propose again to refresh the table.
soil.params.title: Engineering parameters
soil.params.subtitle: Per layer: candidates from correlations and laboratory data, your selection, and approval. Only approved values become design values.
soil.params.no_profiles: There are no soil profiles yet. Create one in Soil profiles first.
soil.params.suggest_all_hint: Refreshes candidates and suggestions for every layer. Nothing is approved.
soil.params.approve_ready_hint: Approves every value of this layer that has an applied selection and is not yet approved.
soil.params.stale_hint: The layer bounds or inputs changed after approval on {date}. The old value ({value}) is no longer approved: select again and re-approve.
soil.params.revoked_hint: Changing the selection revokes its approval.
soil.params.no_candidates: No applicable correlation or laboratory value for this layer.
soil.params.no_suggestion: The program has no suggestion for this value.
soil.params.k_sd_hint: Required; the program does not default it.
soil.params.unapplied: Unapplied changes: apply the selection before approving.
soil.params.pick_needed: Choose how to select a value.
soil.params.no_data_banner: This layer has no usable SPT, CPT or laboratory data, so the Suggested, Method and Statistic options are disabled. Add data to the profile's source boreholes (Site data) or enter the values manually.
soil.params.no_sources_banner: No borehole or CPT is linked to this profile, so no parameter can be produced. On the Soil profiles page pick the SPT/CPT records in the profile's 'Source tests' field, or enter the values manually.
soil.params.manual_only_hint: No data for this value; only manual entry is available.
soil.params.reapply_needed: The earlier approval no longer holds. Apply the selection again (it is re-evaluated on the current candidates) and check the value before approving.
soil.params.outdated_hint: The candidates changed after this selection was applied, so the shown value is not what would be approved. Apply the selection again.
soil.params.approve_confirm_body: Layer {layer}: the values below will be approved as design values.
soil.params.bulk_blocked_dirty: Apply or discard the unapplied selections first.
soil.params.bulk_none: No value is ready to approve.
soil.layering.gamma_note: Unit weights are suggested or typed values; the source is shown under each cell. Every value is editable. When you change one, the suggestions of the layers below are refreshed and your own entries are kept. The profile stores only the number.
soil.cls.title: Soil classification
soil.cls.subtitle: CPT behaviour type (Robertson SBTn) and laboratory classification (USCS, ASTM D2487).
soil.cls.scope_note: The classification engine does not identify organic soils (OL, OH, Pt): that needs the oven-dried liquid limit. SBTn zones 8 and 9 are off by default and are not shown. Chart curves are clipped to the plotted axes; the A-line and U-line become negative below LL 20 and LL 8 and are not drawn there.
soil.cls.sbtn.empty_desc: Import a CPT sounding on the Site data page to see its soil behaviour type.
soil.cls.sbtn.chart_label: Robertson SBTn chart, Qtn against Fr on logarithmic axes
soil.cls.sbtn.hidden_points: {count} sample(s) lie outside the plotted axes and are not drawn.
soil.cls.sbtn.no_zoned_points: No sample could be assigned to a zone.
soil.cls.sbtn.zones_89_note: Zones 8 and 9 are disabled by default in the engine.
soil.cls.uscs.empty_desc: Import a borehole with laboratory records on the Site data page to classify it.
soil.cls.uscs.chart_label: Plasticity chart, plasticity index against liquid limit
soil.cls.uscs.hidden_points: {count} sample(s) lie outside the plotted axes and are not drawn.
soil.cls.uscs.no_lab: This borehole has no laboratory records.
soil.cls.uscs.quick_hint: Enter laboratory values; empty fields are treated as not measured and the engine reports what it had to assume.
soil.error.depth_outside_title: Source is deeper than the active profile
soil.error.depth_outside: The active soil profile reaches {profile_depth} m, but this source goes down to {source_depth} m. Stresses for layering come from the active profile. Extend the active profile (or make a deeper one active) on the Soil profiles page, then try again.
soil.error.depth_outside_nosrc: The active soil profile reaches only {profile_depth} m, shallower than this source. Stresses for layering come from the active profile. Extend the active profile (or make a deeper one active) on the Soil profiles page, then try again.
soil.layering.stress_profile_note: Stresses use the active profile; it must be at least as deep as the source.
soil.params.stale_reason.stress_changed: The stress basis changed (γ, γsat or water table). This method uses σ′v.
soil.params.stale_reason.dependency_chan: The φ′ (or OCR) it depends on changed.
soil.params.stale_reason.method_upgraded: The approval record format was upgraded; the data has changed since the approval.
soil.params.method_gone: The selected method no longer applies; make a new selection.
soil.params.reapprove_done: The selected approvals were renewed with the current values.
soil.params.reapprove_conflict: The current value changed while you were looking; the list was reloaded. Review the value and try again.
soil.params.review_stale_hint: Lists withdrawn approvals whose current value can be computed. Nothing is approved automatically.
soil.params.review_none: No withdrawn approval can be renewed with a current value.
soil.params.review_intro: Review every row; only the rows you tick are approved again.
soil.params.unit_weight_first: Approve the unit weights first: every correlation that depends on σ′v rests on them. If γ changes, approvals that use σ′v need approval again.
soil.params.gamma_sat_missing_below_gwt: The layer lies below the water table and γsat is not entered: stress-dependent correlations cannot be computed and analyses will stop. Enter γsat from the laboratory, the CPT or by hand, and approve it.
soil.params.gamma_sat_equals_gamma_unapp: γsat = γ and it is not approved (older files had the program set γsat equal to γ). Check it and approve it.
soil.params.gamma_sat_missing_short: γsat missing below the water table
soil.layering.merge_gamma_warning: The merged layers had different unit weights: thickness-weighted γ = {gamma}, γsat = {gamma_sat} kN/m³ written (γsat only when both layers have it). Approve again.
soil.layering.merge_c_eff_conflict: The layers have different c′: not merged because a number is required. Make c′ equal first.
soil.layering.not_aligned: Elevations are missing: depths were combined without alignment.
soil.layering.resolution.label: Conflict resolution
soil.layering.create_blocked_conflict: For the conflicting layers, choose which data applies.
